newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ERICSSON SIGNS 110 MLN CONTRACT IN CHINA.
newsitem.headline: ERICSSON SIGNS 110 MLN CONTRACT IN CHINA.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday that it had signed a major GSM expansion contract in China worth 110 million.
The contract was with the Heilongjiang Posts and Telecommunications Administration (HLJPTA) in Heilongjiang Province.
It said this was the second expansion contract of the GSM network in this province.
"As a result of this expansion, the GSM network will achieve a capacity of 800,000 subscribers," Ericsson said in a statement.
Under the contract, Ericsson will introduce microradio base stations which enable rapid and smooth deployment of high capacity network.
In addition base stations for GSM 1800 to the existing GSM 900 network will pave the way for the future introduction of personal communication.
Ericsson said it had entered into a longterm cooperation with HLJPTA and was in the process of setting up a technical service centre in the province.
